params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection. Defaults to 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set. Verified live: values outside 1-100 return HTTP 400 `rest_invalid_param`.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Only `view` and `embed` are available anonymously — `edit` returns HTTP 401.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to. Verified live, e.g. `_fields=id,slug,link,title`.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to items with one of the given slugs.
